Method of Attack: Information-stealing malware targeting web browsers and cryptocurrency wallet apps; uses fake blockchain games as delivery mechanism; password stealing via AppleScript and osascript spoofing; extracts data from macOS keychain database; uses Terminal window to prompt for password to dump Keychain credentials; installs Python cryptography library to dump credentials from Keychain
Attack Vector: Fake blockchain games distributed via social media and Discord channels; direct messages with access codes to download fake game clients; PKG installers or DMG disk files containing malicious Mach-O files for macOS
Indicators of Compromise: Fake game names: Brawl Earth, WildWorld, Dawnland, Destruction, Evolion, Pearl, Olymp of Reptiles, SaintLegend; use of revoked Apple Developer IDs or ad-hoc code signatures; presence of 'game.py' (cross-platform Firefox infostealer) and 'installer.py' (chainbreaker); folders named 'data' in user home, working directory, or parent game folder; strings targeting macOS 14 Sonoma in about 30% of samples
